datasets.name: HERIDAL
datasets.source_organization: IPSAR project, University of Split and collaborators
datasets.citation: Deep Learning Approach in Aerial Imagery for Supporting Land Search and Rescue Missions, https://doi.org/10.1007/s11263-019-01177-1
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Wilderness aerial search candidate. Official distribution and annotation details require confirmation.

datasets.name: VisDrone
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Drone footage of everyday scenes. Group by flight; crowd and occlusion labels need mapping.

datasets.name: HIT-UAV
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Aerial infrared object detection. Inspect thermal encoding and size of distant people.

datasets.name: FLIR ADAS
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Road-level driving perspective. Visible and thermal streams exist; verify registration per release.

datasets.name: KAIST Multispectral
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Vehicle-mounted aligned RGB and thermal images. Day/night traffic differs from aerial disaster scenes.

datasets.name: FloodNet
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Post-flood UAV scenes. Geographic and event coverage limit generalization.

datasets.name: RescueNet
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Post-disaster UAV segmentation. Building condition labels need a documented mapping.

datasets.name: xBD
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable people, properties and location disclosure.
datasets.limitations: Pre/post disaster satellite scenes. Keep matched geographic footprints together; scale differs from UAV imagery.

datasets.name: AudioSet
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable voices and source permissions.
datasets.limitations: Online video excerpts. Availability and rights vary by item; clip tags provide weak timing.

datasets.name: ESC-50
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable voices and source permissions.
datasets.limitations: Environmental recordings. Small curated clips lack airborne platform noise.

datasets.name: FSD50K
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review identifiable voices and source permissions.
datasets.limitations: Freesound recordings. Track clip-level rights and source-recording groups.

datasets.name: Smoke Detection IoT
annotation_types: Binary Fire Alarm target in source project
datasets.privacy_considerations: Recording times and locations may identify collection sites.
datasets.limitations: Published experimental target; independent verification and the local label-generation procedure are unresolved. Two pairs of runs repeat 11 sensor channels and alarm labels. eCO2 is estimated.

datasets.name: UCI Air Quality
datasets.source_organization: Saverio De Vito, UCI Machine Learning Repository
datasets.privacy_considerations: Review release metadata and recording-site granularity.
datasets.limitations: CSV and worksheet encode the same hourly timestamps at different precision. Mask -200. Resolve CC BY 4.0 and research-only statements before admission.

datasets.name: USGS Water Data
annotation_types: Hydrological time series with source qualifiers
datasets.privacy_considerations: Check station-level metadata and any partner restrictions.
datasets.limitations: One station, overlapping summary periods of parent daily statistics. No continuous readings, sample timestamps, timezone, flood thresholds or event labels. Export provenance and governance pending.
